description: ANSWERS "which bills drew the most Senate amendments" / "most amended bills in the 119th Congress" / "how many floor amendments did <bill> get", US FEDERAL Congress. Ranks bills by the number of floor amendments (Senate SAMDT or House HAMDT) offered to them, from a stored amendment table built from Library of Congress, congress.gov amendment data (the live list does not say which bill an amendment belongs to). Every response carries data_as_of and a coverage block: `complete:false` means the table is still filling and counts are lower bounds. Errors with stored_copy_unavailable while the table for that Congress and chamber is not loaded. Returns rank, bill, title, amendments.

chamber.description: Which chamber's amendments to count (default senate).

name: congress_amendment_counts
title: Congress Amendment Counts
